symptoms: RUQ or epigastric pain, nausea, vomiting, anorexia, low grade fever, jaundice
Abdominal tenderness, guarding, positive Murphy's sign

management_steps.details: ABCs, IV line. Fluid resuscitation: 20 mls/kg Balsol or Ringer's Lactate if shocked. Augmentin 1.2g IV STAT.

Antiemetics, analgesia. POCUS / Ultrasound features: Gallstones/sludge, gallbladder wall thickening (>3mm), gallbladder distention (>4cm x >10cm), pericholecystic fluid, dilated bile ducts, air in GB wall, Sonographic Murphy sign.
